share.title: KQCMM Share Karein
share.message: KQCMM — English, Hinglish aur Urdu mein duas, khatm, fateha aur zyada
share.unsupported: Share karne ke liye link copy karein

onboarding.title: KQCMM mein khush aamdeed
onboarding.welcomeBody: Is app mein duas, khatm, fateha khwani, sijrah nama, biographies aur Islami calendar sab hain. Ek chhota sa tour le lein — asaan hai, aur aap kabhi bhi skip ya dobara dekh sakte hain.
onboarding.readAloud: Content ko khuli kitab ya e-book ki tarah padhein — ek card ke baad doosra, bade aur saaf harf mein.

home-links.title: Yahan se shuru karein — home cards
home-links.body: Ye cards aapka main darwaza hain. Dua par tap karke duas padhein, Khatm-e-Khwajagan khatm ke liye, Sijrah Nama, Fateha Khwani, biographies aur mazeed. Har card ek section khulta hai. Bade aur asaan dabaane ke liye hain.

content-reading.title: Ek page padhna
content-reading.body: Jab aap koi section kholeinge to content cards ki shakal mein bade saaf harf mein aayega — jaise ek khuli kitab. Neeche scroll karke har card padhein. Neeche ek counter (+, -) milega taake aap duaa ya zikr ko gin saken, aur aage peechhe jane ke buttons bhi. Ek chhota book icon (quick jump) bhi hai jisse aap seedha kisi bhi hisse tak ja sakte hain.

header-menu.title: Menu button
header-menu.body: Is button ko dabayein — poori menu khul jaati hai. Isme har page hai — Home, biographies, Fateha Khwani, Khatm, Roshni, Duas, Calendar aur About. Kabhi bhi Home jane ke liye menu mein Home chunein ya neeche house icon dabayein.

header-settings.title: Settings — apne hisaab se banayein
header-settings.body: Is gear ko dabayein to app ka layout badal sakte hain. Zaban chunein, theme (rang) aankhon ke liye asaan banayein, text ka size bada ya chhota karein, aur font badlein. Kuch bhi bigar nahi sakta — kabhi bhi wapas aakar theek kar sakte hain.

hijri-strip.title: Islami tareekh ki patti
hijri-strip.body: Ye patti upar se thodi neeche aaj ki Hijri aur Gregorian tareekh dikhati hai, aur khaas events bhi mark karti hai. Is par tap karein to poora Islami Calendar khulta hai, jahan aap mahine dekh sakte hain aur ahem tareekhein milti hain.

welcome.title: Assalamu Alaikum, khush aamdeed
welcome.body: Is app mein duas, khatm, fateha khwani, sijrah nama, biographies aur Islami calendar sab hain. Ek chhota sa tour le lein — asaan hai, aur aap kabhi bhi skip ya dobara dekh sakte hain.

choose-fateha.title: Fateha Khwani chunein
choose-fateha.body: Home page par Fateha Khwani card ko khud dabayein. Hum aapke intezar mein rahenge.

slide-next.title: Agla button — ▶
slide-next.body: Neeche buttons dekhein? ▶ button dabayein to agla card khulta hai. Abhi ise dabakar dekhein.

slide-prev.title: Peechla button — ◀
slide-prev.body: Shabash! Ab ◀ button dabayein — ek card peeche. Jaise kitab ka waraq ulatna.

slide-end.title: Shuru ya aakhir tak jump
slide-end.body: ⏮ button pehle card par le jaata hai, aur ⏭ seedha aakhri card par. Ab ⏭ dabayein — ye woh hai jisme do arrow right ki taraf hain.

counter-inc.title: Counter — ginne ke liye
counter-inc.body: Plus (+) button aapke liye gin leta hai, ek dabane par ek. Jab aap koi dua ya zikr baar baar padhte hain to ye bahut kaam aata hai. Ab + button dabayein aur number badhta dekhein.

counter-dec.title: Counter — neeche aana
counter-dec.body: Agar galti se zyada daba diya to − (minus) button se neeche aa sakte hain. Ab − button dabakar dekhein.

counter-reset.title: Counter — dobara shuru
counter-reset.body: ↺ button count ko wapas zero kar deta hai, taake aap nayi shuruaat kar saken. Ab ↺ button dabayein.

choose-sijrah.title: Sijrah Nama chunein
choose-sijrah.body: Home par wapas aakar Sijrah Nama card ko khud dabayein.

return-home-sijrah.title: Home wapas jayein
return-home-sijrah.body: Ab Sijrah Nama chunnay ke liye neeche Home button dabayein.

choose-roshni.title: Roshni chunein
choose-roshni.body: Neeche bottom navigation bar mein Roshni button ko dabayein.

return-home-roshni.title: Home wapas jayein
return-home-roshni.body: Ab Roshni chunnay ke liye neeche Home button dabayein.

choose-dua.title: Duas chunein
choose-dua.body: Neeche bottom navigation bar mein Dua button ko dabayein.

return-home-dua.title: Home wapas jayein
return-home-dua.body: Ab Duas chunnay ke liye neeche Home button dabayein.

finish.title: Aap tayyar hain
finish.body: Bas itna hi hai. Home se koi bhi card kholein, ya menu se explore karein. Agar chahein to Settings mein Replay walkthrough dabakar ye tour dobara dekh sakte hain.
